title: Universality for cokernels of partially random integral matrices
summary: Given any $\varepsilon > 0$, let $M(n)$ be a random $n \times (n+u)$ matrix over $\mathbb{Z}_p$, with all entries independent and $\varepsilon$-balanced (lying in each residue class mod $p$ with probability at most $1-\varepsilon$). Wood proved that as $n \to \infty$ the distribution of $\mathrm{cok}(M(n))$ approaches Cohen and Lenstra's conjectured distribution of class groups.
